gen-gf-tektur-gf-scope-one: Tektur draws bent-wire letters with generous openings on every curve and oddly oversized lowercase, expressive and a little strange. And Scope One, a classic serif with a big x-height and stubby ascenders, lets a long page of text unfold with counters spilling out into the space around them.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-slabo-13px: Slabo 13px reads bookish and dignified, with large open counters in its tall a, e and s. Tektur above it is all pipe-cleaner strokes with no thick-to-thin shift at all, so the two sit as a strict, drawn headline over a gently shaped text serif.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-suwannaphum: Tektur has a signage-like plainness, every line weight the same, with wide-mouthed curves and oversized lowercase. Suwannaphum follows in a dignified serif whose high, squared-off x-height and bent-paperclip c give the page an editorial, woodblock weight beneath it.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-epunda-slab: Epunda Slab is a dignified serif with a visibly gaping c and tall, rounded lowercase that stay open at any size. Tilt Neon's tube-like, contrast-free strokes sit above it, loud and commanding.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-fauna-one: Fauna One is a literary classic serif, its tall middle band and shallow ascenders giving the e a generous way in. But Tilt Neon above looks drawn with a single pen tip, bold and constant, so the two feel like a shout followed by a thoughtful aside.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-glegoo: Glegoo brings big counters and wide, unclosed mouths on its curved letters, a refined editorial voice. Glegoo, as a classic serif, can go a touch larger than you'd expect, while Tilt Neon's tube-like strokes never vary and carry the heading.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-hanuman: A splayed c terminal gives Tilt Neon its bent-copper-pipe swagger, with a large x-height and short ascenders. Hanuman, a classic serif with a high-waisted lowercase and wide-set terminals on s, lets paragraphs move along in a traditional, refined way.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-kadwa: Tilt Neon draws every letter with one uninterrupted line width, bold and commanding, with a big x-height and short ascenders. Kadwa, a classic serif with open-ended curves and its own larger-than-usual x-height, is the quality that really ties the pair together.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-piazzolla: Technical-pen steadiness, loud and tubular. Piazzolla, a refined text serif whose lowercase nearly matches its capitals and whose e opens like a pried clasp, answers that steadiness with a more authoritative texture beneath the heading.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-pridi: A flat, stencil-like line weight and splayed c terminals define Tilt Neon. It excels at bold, commanding display, while Pridi, a classic serif with generous space inside its curves and near-capital small letters, does the refined, quieter work of text.
